research_findings: Discovered that the AI Chat and Evaluate endpoints lacked explicit IP-based rate limiting, which is necessary to prevent abuse of the platform's AI capabilities.
Identified that @upstash/ratelimit and @upstash/redis are the standard rate limiting libraries used in this Next.js project based on the memory rules.
Noted that `check-env.ts` handles graceful degradation if optional environment variables are missing.
features_improved: Optimized AI routing infrastructure by introducing robust rate limiting.
Gracefully handled missing rate limiting credentials to prevent local dev or CI crashes.
new_features_added: Added Upstash Redis-based rate limiting to the core AI chat API route (`/api/ai/chat/route.ts`).
Added Upstash Redis-based rate limiting to the core AI evaluate API route (`/api/ai/evaluate/route.ts`).
next_steps_for_next_run: Consider applying the global rate limiter to general public-facing endpoints.
Enhance observability by hooking up analytics to the rate limiter events.
